name: Gari Tim Simulator
description: Uleteo/la si u MKDSLend sastanak koji vec traje. Imas jedan sastanak da se snades, izaberes odgovore, steknesh affinity — i mozda, ako si dovoljno primetljiv/a, zavrsis sa zadatkom koji ti odgovara.

modules.index.html: Entry point, linka sve CSS i main.js modul
modules.styles/theme.css: CSS custom properties: boje likova, tipografija, spacing
modules.styles/base.css: Base layout, body, full-screen app, scrollbar
modules.styles/ui.css: Dialogue box, choice buttons, share card komponente
modules.styles/game.css: Typing animacije, fade tranzicije, scene enter animacije
modules.src/main.js: State machine, scene runner, orkestrira sve module
modules.src/audio.js: AudioManager: Web Audio API ambient, click, ding, scene-specific sounds
modules.src/share.js: shareResult() Web Share API, copyToClipboard() fallback, showCopyFeedback()
modules.src/systems/dialogue.js: DialogueEngine: processNode(), handleChoice() sa affinity delta
modules.src/systems/scenes.js: loadScene(n, state) -> first node ID za scenu
modules.src/content/characters.js: CHARACTERS: name, color, cssClass, role, aforizmi po liku
modules.src/content/dialogue_tree.js: DIALOGUE_NODES: kompletno stablo dijloga Scene 0-8, dule micro-scene
modules.src/content/endings_content.js: ENDINGS: title, narration, shareText, characterColor za endings 1-6
modules.src/content/share_texts.js: SHARE_TEXTS per ending za Web Share API
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: AFORIZMI i getRandomAforizm() za flavor text
